item.title: Clayton schools to go to remote learning for Wednesday and Thursday
item.description: CLAYTON, N.M. (KRQE) – Clayton schools will shift to remote learning for Wednesday and Thursday due to an increase in people getting sick. The district said it will allow them to deep clean and disinfect all schools to help ensure the health and safety of students and staff.

item.description: NEW MEXICO (KRQE) – Rail Runner service was disrupted Tuesday evening after officials said a train hit a trespasser on the tracks.
